However, in cases where the court adjudicated the matters on merits with substantial enhancement, the Petitioner had challenged the said orders before the Hon’ble High Court of Kerala, which had granted conditional stays on the enhancement orders, subject to deposit of 50-60% of the enhanced amounts in the Hon’ble Court.
